name: Conflict resolution: three strategies, three firing orders
note: Run Forward chaining three times, changing the conflict-resolution strategy. All three derive exactly the same facts, but the firing order differs. In the first cycle the conflict set holds R1 ann, R2 ann and R3 bob: rule order fires R1 ann (the first rule listed), recency fires R3 bob (it uses the newest fact), specificity fires R2 ann (two conditions beat one). Compare the conflict-set table in cycle 1 and the 'Firing order' in the last caption.
